title: Security
intro: Sign-in methods of this account. Before every change, DMN Zeit asks again for the password and code or for a passkey.
lastFactor: This is the last second factor. Set up a passkey or the authenticator app first, then it can be removed.

setup.intro: To sign in, the account needs a second factor besides the password. One of the two options is enough, the other can be added later under Security.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.intro: A passkey signs in without a password. It is stored on the device, in a password manager or on a security key.
passkey.name: Name
passkey.nameHint: To recognise it in the list
passkey.removeText: This passkey will no longer sign in. It stays stored on the device or in the password manager and can be deleted there.
passkey.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.intro: An app on the phone generates a new six-digit code every 30 seconds. Signing in with the password asks for it.
totp.scan: Scan the QR code with the authenticator app, then enter the code from the app.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for setting up the authenticator app
totp.manual: Without a camera, enter this key in the app:
totp.wrong: The code is incorrect. Enter the current code from the app, it changes every 30 seconds.
totp.already: An authenticator app is already set up.
totp.removeText: Codes from this app will no longer be accepted. Signing in then works with passkeys.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: For when neither the phone nor a passkey is at hand. Each code works for one sign-in.
recovery.lowHint: Generate new codes before they run out.
recovery.none: Recovery codes are issued once a second factor is set up.
recovery.renewText: All previous codes stop working immediately, including the unused ones.
recovery.shownOnce: These codes are shown only now. When signing in, each of them replaces the code from the app or the passkey once.
recovery.saved: I have stored the codes in a safe place.

reauth.title: Confirm again
reauth.intro: This change needs a fresh confirmation. It then stays valid for 10 minutes.
reauth.wrongPasskey: This passkey does not belong to this account.

sessions.intro: Where the account is signed in right now. A session ends after 12 hours without activity, after 7 days at the latest.
sessions.onlyThis: The account is not signed in anywhere else.
sessions.hint: The list of sessions shows where the account is signed in right now. Single sessions can be ended there.
